en: A black-and-white photograph featuring three young men in what appears to be a tailor’s workshop. One stands at a worktable with fabric, another sits at a vintage sewing machine, and the third appears to be working with fabric on his lap. Coats and vests hang on the wall in the background, giving the setting a clear sense of craft and trade. The photo has a candid, documentary style.
